message: I've had my fair share of unexpected blackouts, and let me tell you, there's nothing quite like the panic of realizing your phone is about to die right when you need it most. That's why I found this resource from the Red Cross so helpful; it gives practical tips for preparing for those pesky power outages. A little planning can go a long way in keeping things calm and collected when the lights go out. What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared during a blackout?
